author: claude
summary: Task 001 of the voices-variants-round2 plan: fixes a live P1 bug where the Voices catalog page's card icon rendered broken. VoiceCatalogCard.tsx built its straight from the raw stored metadata.image path instead of routing through the /api/voices/{id}/icon endpoint every other icon consumer (e.g. VoiceLabPage.tsx) already uses.

files.change: Changed iconUrl derivation from `metadata?.image ?? null` to `metadata?.image ? \`/api/voices/${encodeURIComponent(speaker.id)}/icon\` : null`, matching the existing pattern in VoiceLabPage.tsx:176. No other logic changed.
Added a regression test asserting the avatar renders via the /api/voices/{id}/icon endpoint rather than the raw metadata.image value.

flow_impact: First landed task of the voices-variants-round2 plan (docs/design-critique/voices-variants-round2/). Plan folder: ~/.claude/plans/audiobook-factory/voices-variants-round2/. Remaining 9 tasks (catalog card action consolidation, icon-upload consolidation, MultiSelect primitive + catalog filters, attribute single-select, Voice Lab tab-IA collapse, spec sync) still in flight.
